pattern: proxy finish LIGHT (proxy_finish.py stage_light + proxy_finish_light.py): the frozen Pixal3D sheet proxy kept as generated (geometry + texture), made watertight, decimated, baked, optionally reposed with bones

refloor.why: sheet_proxy floored the TAIL (a flat curl lying on the ground under / behind the hind legs, z 0.00..0.55 at y 0.55..2.9, |x| up to 1.8); the four paws hang above it (front -x paw z 0.632, front +x 0.608, hind -x 0.771, hind +x 0.855). The floor goes to the lowest FRONT paw contact (window y -3.1..-0.5, |x| >= 0.3, the lowest claw tip z 0.608), then x1.1146 to the sheet front height 6.28. The hind paws then hover 0.18 / 0.27 u (proxy as generated: the whole body pitched ~4.6 deg nose-down; light flow, no repose)

config.midline_x_why: the body's mirror plane to x 0: eye texel centres x -0.011 / 0.450 (mid 0.219), front paws -0.67 / 1.11 (mid 0.22), hind paws -0.67 / 1.06 (mid 0.20) after refloor; sheet_proxy centred the BBOX, which the lateral tail curl skews

dense.why: v2: the GRAFTED head (light.head_graft body bbox x -0.71..0.71, y -3.36..-1.26, z 4.75..6.55): snout, horn-scale crest, jaw; vg_weight 0.3 so the face box below can sit denser
v2: the grafted FACE: snout tip (0, -3.36, 5.42), eyes (+-0.28, -2.73, 5.61), chin (0, -3.10, 5.04), mouth line held densest so the eye / jaw paint stays crisp
the rebuilt tail tube: held denser so the r 0.04..0.46 tube stays round under the collapse decimation (spring_pig lesson: at the base density a tube decimates to a faceted ribbon)

cuts.why: the proxy's lower tail (the descending sweep and the floor curl below the cut line z 1.15) behind the hind legs: the +x hind heel / hock reaches y 1.65 (x 0.2..0.8, z 0.4..1.2), the -x one y 1.4
the +x arm of the proxy's floor curl (x 0.77..1.6, y 1.4..2.0, z <= 0.7) beside the +x hind heel (heel x <= 0.8 here)
everything below the floor after refloor = the proxy's tail mat (proxy z 0..0.55 -> -0.68..-0.06; one voxel margin under the lowest claw tip z 0.000)
v2 head graft: the proxy's own crushed head IN FRONT of the throat (the beak y -3.38..-2.45, z >= 4.75); the cream throat front below z 4.75 (sheet side view: the neck front at y ~-2.55) is kept

v2 head graft: the proxy's crushed face / head top above the neck (y -2.45..-1.75, z >= 4.9: its yellow eyes at z 4.75..5.11 and the crest above them); below z 4.9 the neck stays and the graft's flat block bottom (z 4.77..4.88) sinks into it; behind y -1.75 the proxy's own swept-back crest / dorsal spines are kept so they wrap the graft's rear (its clip cap at y -1.26..-1.36)

v2 head graft: the proxy's old muzzle tip under the graft's jaw (a rounded knob x -0.15..0.15, z 4.4..4.8, front y ~-2.45 that read as a second nose); the graft's stump (q1 -0.32 -> -0.62, body z 4.95 -> 4.2) fills the throat in its place, so the cut stops at the stump's bottom z 4.2 (run 2 stopped at z 4.3 in front of a shallower stump: a notch)

light.cuts_why: UNIT NOTE (orchestrator): the sheet draws a LONG powerful scaled tail sweeping down and back to the floor; the proxy's tail is a thick flat mat lying 0.6 u BELOW the paws (Pixal3D read the sheet's perspective floor literally: the sheet side-view tail tip sits at v 822, the claws at v ~760). The tail below z 1.15 and everything below the floor is removed (also from the bake source); the upper tail root (z >= 1.15, with its dorsal spines and scale texture) is kept as generated

segment_array.why: v2.1 (artist 2026-10-17 'Drakescale Beast v2 tail note': "lets just extend and duplicate exisiting tails and end in a point"): the v1/v2 capsule tube (light.adds + the recolour paint bands) is gone; the tail is the proxy's OWN scaled tail-root segment duplicated. Source = the generated root below the rump (box x +-0.95, y 1.75..3.45, z 1.15..1.95, a ring of pangolin plates x -0.86..0.63 / y 1.75..3.31 clear of the hind legs, dorsal spines on its +y side), axis from the ring centre at z 1.95 (y 2.40) to z 1.15 (y 2.68), 0.85 u. Its hollow skin cavity is filled so the copies are solid plugs. 7 copies along the sheet's side-view tail: centreline traced on the sheet side view through the stage-1 side registration (u = 882.26 + 100 y, v = 803.96 - 100 z): (1137,700) -> (2.55, 1.04), (1140,740) -> (2.58, 0.64), (1105,785) -> (2.23, 0.19), (1060,806) -> (1.78, -0.02), (1000,812) -> (1.18, -0.08), tip (955,821) -> (0.73, -0.17); the drop below the floor (the sheet's perspective) is lifted so each copy rests ON the floor (centre z ~ its half thickness, floor_z 0 flattens the contact). Scale 0.85^i per copy, 20% overlap (each copy's plates shingle over the next), the last copy 2x long with its cross-section ramped to 0.02 = the point

recolour3d.name: tone_curve
recolour3d.why: UNIT NOTE (tone): the proxy texture reads dark olive / khaki: proxy texels L* p10/50/90 18.4 / 28.3 / 52.0, a* 2.4..5.1, b* 6.7..22.1 (dark band L* < 25 median 58,48,38 = L* 20.7 a* 2.8 b* 8.0) vs the sheet front + side masks L* 16.1 / 33.6 / 62.0 (dark band 54,41,36 = L* 18.0 a* 4.9 b* 3.9; median-luma pixels 95,75,66). ONE tone curve over every texel (storm_bear idiom, no posterised borders): new = target x (luma / median)^1.24 (run 1 target 97,76,66 gave basecolor L* p10/50/90 12.2 / 29.2 / 61.9 vs the sheet 16.1 / 33.6 / 62.0 (AO x~0.88): lifted to 104,82,71; the sheet median-luma colour 95,75,66; exponent = the log-quantile fit q10..q90 proxy -> sheet luma); simulated on the proxy texels: L* 19.4 / 32.6 / 67.8, dark band a* 5.3 b* 6.8, mid 7.4 / 9.3. v2: no eye exclusion (the proxy's old eyes are cut / erased; the grafted head's texture is toned separately, light.head_graft.tone)

recolour3d.name: tone_copper_cream
recolour3d.why: the mid / bright texels (L* >= 40: copper scale tips, belly) re-hued to the sheet's copper hue (sheet L* >= 50 median 181,141,114; chips 188,146,115 / 220,187,156) with their luminance kept (target = the hue 178,140,108 scaled to the selected texels' median luma = 158,125,96, gamma 1). Run 1 (L* >= 52 to 190,154,133) left basecolor b* 12.1 / 15.3 in the L* 40-55 / 55-70 bands vs the sheet 17.9 / 20.1 (the renders read mauve-grey); simulated now (x0.88 AO): L* p10/50/90 16.7 / 32.3 / 67.3, b* 17.7 / 22.9

recolour3d.name: tone_dark_scale
recolour3d.why: the darkest scale texels (L* <= 24) still read yellow after the curve (b* 6.8 vs the sheet 3.9): re-hued to the sheet's dark scale (L* < 25 median 54,41,36; chip 72,57,48), luminance kept (target lifted with the curve); simulated a* 4.7 b* 4.9

light.bake_drop_interior_why: proxy faces with solid on both sides (inner shells under the overlapping scale plates) left out of the bake source so the cage stays tight
light.ao_why: AO baked on the watertight low (the scale-plate soup's inner shells black-hole AO rays); 0.2 u keeps the crevices between the scale plates without the broad darkening (lesson: AO darkens the basecolor)

head_graft.frame_why: the head glb (as stored, glTF axes) is a full 3D head built TURNED: its snout points along (-cos 37, 0, sin 37) and it rolls 6 deg. Mirror search (scratch head_fine.py): the face (within 0.45 of the snout tip) mirrored about the plane through the tip, yaw 35..44 x roll -4..10 x offset -0.03..0.03 -> best yaw 37 roll 6 (mean mirror distance 0.0059 glb units, i.e. 0.014 u); in that frame both eyes sit at q2 +0.115 / -0.094 and the snout tip at +0.011, so mid_z 0.006 (between the geometric 0.0007 and the landmark 0.011). The good half = q2 >= 0, the side facing the generation camera (the sheet panel's side)
head_graft.place_why: one similarity (head q0, q1) -> (body y, z) least-squares on three landmarks: head snout tip (-0.494, -0.145), eye centre (-0.245, -0.056), chin (-0.375, -0.295) [glb units, the head frame] onto the SHEET SIDE VIEW snout tip px (577, 278), eye (634, 260), chin (600, 313) through v1's body-only side registration y = (u - 888) / 93, z = (782 - v) / 93 (the one the v1 tail used; head / legs window IoU 0.795) = (-3.344, 5.419), (-2.731, 5.613), (-3.097, 5.043); residuals 0.011 / 0.008 / 0.011 u. The proxy's own (crushed) eye sat at (+-0.23, -2.0, 4.93): 0.7 u lower and 0.7 u further back than the sheet's
head_graft.clip_why: the head block ends in a flat wall where the head panel's frame cut it (q0 0.40..0.43); the graft stops at q0 0.34 (body y -1.26 top .. -1.36 bottom) inside the proxy neck, whose dorsal spines continue behind it

tone.why: the head glb texture reads charcoal / olive next to the toned body: its face-half texels (q2 > 0, q0 < 0.3; scratch tone_stats.py) L* p10/50/90 18.7 / 29.8 / 56.4, per L* band median a*/b* (1.6, 6.8) (5.3, 13.8) (8.7, 20.8) (2.0, 15.2) (1.9, 17.8) vs the sheet HEAD panel 11.8 / 35.3 / 68.9 with (4.1, 3.0) (5.7, 5.1) (12.7, 19.3) (11.1, 21.2) (7.7, 20.0), the sheet side-view head 22.3 / 40.6 / 74.0 and the v1 toned neck 17.8 / 31.9 / 70.5. L* mapped onto the neck / sheet quantiles (p90 66: the cream jaw lifted from grey to cream), a*/b* shifted per band to the sheet panel (the mid band toward the neck: b* 6.5). The orange eye (a* >= 15 and b* >= 40) is kept as generated

head_graft.why: UNIT V2 NOTE (a), artist 2026-10-17 'Drakescale Beast v1 head note': the proxy's head is crushed (three re-seeds gave the same snout). The orchestrator's head-only Pixal3D mesh from the sheet's HEAD DETAIL panel (seed 56) replaces it: its good half mirrored (a symmetric head, the generated face), scaled / placed on the sheet's side-view head, unioned at the neck
head_graft.stump_taper_why: stump: the head block ends in a flat bottom (q1 -0.36..-0.40, body z 4.77..4.88) where the panel cut the throat; its cross-section at q1 -0.32 (the throat just behind the jaw, front at body y ~-2.59: the sheet side view draws the throat front at y -2.6..-2.5 from the jaw down to z 4.3) is continued straight down to q1 -0.62 (body z ~4.2, inside the chest), so the throat meets the neck and buries the proxy's old muzzle knob (x -0.15..0.15, z 4.4..4.8, front y -2.45; run 2 cut it instead and left a notch). taper: the block's back (q0 0.20..0.34, body y -1.64..-1.30) shrinks smoothly by up to 0.45 u into the proxy neck, so no flat cap shows behind the head (run 1: a flat dark cap face at y -1.26..-1.36 above the neck)
head_graft.drop_why: bake source: graft faces buried > 0.06 u inside the new grid or floating > 0.03 u outside it (the taper's shrunk-away block back; with them in, proxy-to-low p99 0.236 -> bake cage 0.71 u) leave the bake source

erase3d.why: v2: the remnant of the proxy's old -x eye (yellow texels, box x -0.36..-0.09, y -2.14..-1.77, z 4.75..5.11) below the head-graft cut line z 4.9, refilled from the surrounding neck
v2: the remnant of the proxy's old +x eye (box x 0.07..0.43, y -2.27..-1.72, z 4.75..5.11), refilled

chains.name: arm
chains.why: v2 (measured on the v2 pre-repose low, |x| > 0.2 side views + z-slab centroids, scratch legview.py): points = the +x front leg, points_R = the -x front leg as generated: shoulder (set symmetric inside the chest, y -1.05, z 2.9), elbow (z 1.4: +x (1.16, -0.80) / -x (-1.15, -1.95)), wrist (z 0.5: 0.92, -1.00 / -0.95, -2.30), toes (z 0.1: front claw tips y -1.6 / -2.85): the -x front leg reaches 1.25 u further forward (a stride); the repose makes the pair symmetric at the mean

chains.name: leg
chains.why: v2: points = the +x hind leg, points_R = the -x hind leg as generated: hip (inside the haunch, symmetric), knee (z 1.4: +x (0.70, 1.05) / -x (-0.78, 1.00)), heel (+x (0.68, 1.10, 0.65) raised / -x (-0.80, 0.85, 0.35)), toes (+x (0.60, 0.30, 0.35) hovering 0.27 u / -x (-0.80, 0.10, 0.08) on the floor); plantigrade paws, toes forward

chains.name: tail
chains.why: v2.1: the kept proxy tail root (z >= 1.15, centre (0, 2.55, 2.2)) then the segment_array copies' starts (light.segment_array report) to the tip: a 7-bone CENTRED tail chain on x = 0 (mirror false), so the duplicated tail rests on the midline and can be posed to either side

rig.spine_why: v2: hips / belly / chest as v1; neck root (0, -1.5, 4.1) up the neck to the head pivot (0, -1.9, 5.3; behind the grafted eyes y -2.73, inside the head-neck junction, the graft's clip cap y -1.26..-1.36); the head bone runs to the grafted snout tip (0, -3.35, 5.43): the graft is symmetric and on x = 0, so the head heading is straight -y

clips.why: PLACEHOLDER (movement + in-game height are the open artist questions): idle = breathe + the kit's tail sway; walk = a four-leg step; leg_swing 8 (lesson: the kit walk dips the feet below the floor)

config._doc: LIGHT finish of the raw Pixal3D proxy (seed 56, front + side views, sha 197465d1). Points: stage-1 frame (front paws on the floor, x1.1146 to the sheet front height 6.28, body midline x 0.22 -> 0), sheet units. The tail below z 1.15 is the one rebuilt region (light.cuts + light.adds + light.recolour), generated by a Catmull-Rom script (parameters in adds_why); tone = light.recolour3d (texture only).

targets.why: artist 2026-10-17: a symmetric rest pose. The two front legs mirror-symmetric at the mean (the -x leg strode 1.25 u forward), both paws planted on the floor
targets.radius_why: [reach, taper] per bone, wide and soft: offline sweep on the v2 pre-repose low (scratch rep_sweep.py) - reach 0.55..0.75 / taper 0.12..0.2 at falloff 0.03 left the paw claws OUTSIDE every limb bone (the nearest bone was then the tail tip on the floor, which does not move): edge stretch p99 3.35, max 11.3; reach 1.4 / 1.0 / 1.1 with taper 0.7 / 0.45 / 0.45 at falloff 0.06: p99 1.34, max 2.65 (mirror p99 the same 0.31)
targets.plant_why: plant_radius 0.8: at 0.5 the claw-tip / heel vertices outside the planted set dipped to z -0.111 after the repose (6 verts; the centring then lifted the paws 0.11 u off the floor); at 0.8 the lowest vertex is z -0.007 (offline, scratch)

targets.why: the two hind legs mirror-symmetric at the mean (the +x paw hovered 0.27 u and sat 0.2 u back), both paws planted
targets.radius_why: [reach, taper] per bone (same sweep): the hind feet's last bone reaches the whole paw; the side-aware rule keeps each side's bones off the other side and off the centred tail tube
targets.plant_why: plant_radius 0.8: at 0.5 the claw-tip / heel vertices outside the planted set dipped to z -0.111 after the repose (6 verts; the centring then lifted the paws 0.11 u off the floor); at 0.8 the lowest vertex is z -0.007 (offline, scratch)

targets.heading: -y
targets.why: the face straight ahead (-y): the grafted head is mirror-symmetric on x = 0 (snout tip x 0.000), so the neck / head yaw is 0 (an identity, stated); the head is RIGID (below)

rigid.why: the grafted head / face (snout, both eyes, jaw, horn-scale crest; the v2 dense head box) moves as ONE rigid body with the head bone: never deformed or re-sculpted

repose.why: v2 (artist 2026-10-17, 'our characters should be symmetrical head turns are done through posing so our models remain flexible'): the proxy's staggered legs are undone with BONES (proxy_finish_repose), never by mirror-averaging geometry; the grafted head is symmetric by construction; the rebuilt tail is centred by construction

segment_array.why: v2.1 (artist 2026-10-17 'Drakescale Beast v2 tail note': "lets just extend and duplicate exisiting tails and end in a point"): the v1/v2 capsule tube (light.adds + the recolour paint bands) is gone; the tail is the proxy's OWN scaled tail-root segment duplicated. Source = the generated root below the rump (box x +-0.95, y 1.75..3.45, z 1.15..1.95, a ring of pangolin plates x -0.86..0.63 / y 1.75..3.31 clear of the hind legs, dorsal spines on its +y side), axis from the ring centre at z 1.95 (y 2.40) to z 1.15 (y 2.68), 0.85 u. Its hollow skin cavity is filled so the copies are solid plugs. 7 copies along the sheet's side-view tail: centreline traced on the sheet side view through the stage-1 side registration (u = 882.26 + 100 y, v = 803.96 - 100 z): (1137,700) -> (2.55, 1.04), (1140,740) -> (2.58, 0.64), (1105,785) -> (2.23, 0.19), (1060,806) -> (1.78, -0.02), (1000,812) -> (1.18, -0.08), tip (955,821) -> (0.73, -0.17); the drop below the floor (the sheet's perspective) is lifted so each copy rests ON the floor (centre z ~ its half thickness, floor_z 0 flattens the contact). Scale 0.85^i per copy, 20% overlap (each copy's plates shingle over the next), the last copy 2x long with its cross-section ramped to 0.02 = the point
segment_array.rule: the proxy segment in `box` copied N times along `curve` (shortest-arc turn onto each chord, uniform scale taper^i, the last copy's cross-section ramped to tip_frac = a point); each copy's pulled-back SDF smooth-unioned into the grid before the remesh; its faces + UVs appended to the bake source; bake faces buried on both sides dropped; originals untouched

high.rule: marching tets of the whole remesh grid (no mirror)

low.method: collapse decimation: uniform to 300000, then 18000 with the dense boxes calibrated

dense.rule: dense boxes weighted 0.02 (vs 1) in the collapse decimation; the factor bisected until the boxes hold density x the rest's triangles per area

ao_fill.rule: AO < below = a bake origin inside the proxy soup: refilled from the covered valid 3x3 neighbours ring by ring (opt-in light.ao_fill_below)

bake.source: the proxy mesh itself (not the remesh)

stretch_all.rule: edge length after / before the repose, edges with a moved vertex

repose.rule: LBS with the contract rig's weights (+ rigid pins), yaw-only straightening (+ lift), applied as rest

stretch_arm.rule: edge length after / before the repose, edges with a moved vertex

stretch_leg.rule: edge length after / before the repose, edges with a moved vertex

stretch_neck_head.rule: edge length after / before the repose, edges with a moved vertex

self_intersections.rule: intersecting triangle pairs sharing no vertex (BVH overlap)

mirror_before.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)

mirror_after.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)

floor.rule: stage 1 floored the FEET at z 0; the centring puts the lowest point at 0

facing.rule: shell centroid -> the front-most midline point of the shell (proxy finish default)

mirror.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)
